name: Jonas Osborne
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember finding out a favor I expected was someone's unpaid afternoon.” Wednesday often includes a stop at the downtown fountain, where Jonas keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I am the regular who complained first. I believed the owner paid for delivery all these years.
appearance: Jonas has full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side. Look for a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Away from the heat of the kitchen, the familiar outfit is a rust-colored canvas coat with a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. In conversation Jonas holds eye contact until the other person has finished.
personality: Jonas has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To correct the complaint about the new fee.
family: Dominic Cho is Jonas’s cousin raised in the same household. Jonas asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Dominic remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *A shelf of apologies*, Dominic says, “I am returning a book to a closed classroom.”
connections: Penelope Tang. The former volunteer tells a regular who really paid for delivery time.
